notes: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, per Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Guides are this entry's own words. Where a launch guide has not yet confirmed an exact trigger, the guide says so instead of guessing. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PSN until earned; this guide hides story trophies behind its spoiler setting.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. It is the last trophy by definition, so plan around A Long Road (100% completion), the longest single requirement. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed, and it is the first story trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you play; chapters cannot be failed permanently, so keep playing the story and it pops at the chapter's end. There is no mission replay, so play each chapter carefully the first time.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Both protagonists are playable from around here, and most of the free-roam trophies open up once Jason and Lucia are both playable, so Chapter 2 is where the wider hunt starts.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start unlocking in Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations come into play alongside the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. One chapter left after this: keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Gold, and the last story trophy. Keep a manual save before the final mission: there is no mission replay, and free-roam continues after the story, so everything left can be cleaned up afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock their trophy the moment they end, so just play the mission through; nothing about it can be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. A story mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy: it is roughly 60% of true completion, including scanning 200 of 277 vehicles, studying 100 of 255 animals and 70 of the 80 challenges. Expect this to be most of the roughly 200 hours to the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts build up across free roam — jumps, near misses and airtime all count — so let the counter climb while you travel between other objectives instead of grinding all 250 in one sitting. Silver.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The official description counts nine types; dip into each one — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest — and the trophy pops as soon as the ninth type registers. No activity needs to be finished or won, just tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Silver. Range challenges can be retried freely, so work through them one at a time until each shows gold; the range also feeds the 100% completion checklist, so this is not wasted effort.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Each location has its own race, and winning each one once is enough; you do not need to win the same race twice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different events count, so work through the race list instead of replaying one favourite — each new event you win moves the counter.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges run through the fishing activity; take one on against Cal and beat his score to pop it. Fishing also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, play a game through to its end, and the trophy pops. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Silver. Stranger strands are the side-mission chains marked on the map; eight finished strands pop it. PowerPyx notes some optional missions disappear after a while, but there are far more strands than eight, so this is not missable — keep taking stranger missions as they appear.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. PowerPyx reports the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. That spot is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, so do it the moment it is offered. The later spots need Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note: 100% completion only needs 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is the only one that can cost you the platinum — meditate whenever the game offers it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at one specific animal; track it down and take it as the mission directs. Hunting also feeds the animal-study count for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Silver. Cards are a collectible scattered across Leonida; finish any three full sets and the trophy pops. Cards stay collectible in free-roam after the story, so nothing about this can be missed.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Silver. WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing app; check in at 100 of its spots across Leonida. It is a long grind, so tick spots off whenever you pass one instead of saving all 100 for the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game tracks 80 challenges in total and any 50 count, so this pops naturally on the way to A Long Road, which needs 70 of the 80. Pick the easy ones first and let the counter climb.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is riding with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Losing the cops with your partner beside you is the whole trick.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies with your partner along, keeping the heat the whole time — do not let the wanted level drop between robberies, or the chain breaks and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles register as you encounter them; 200 of the 277 are needed for 100% completion, so this pops on the way to A Long Road. Drive something new whenever you see it.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus where five or more enemies are in range — a gang shootout or a heavy wanted level — and drop all five before it ends. If the meter runs out early, set up a bigger fight and try again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. Get to a plane on the airfield and take off without following the airport's scripted route — an impromptu, off-schedule departure is what the trophy wants.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The trigger involves the Rhino tank, and no launch guide has published a confirmed method yet — the description is a joke, not instructions, so this guide will not invent one. The obvious first try is getting behind the wheel of a Rhino in free-roam; check PowerPyx's guide for the confirmed method once it is verified.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach: go in quietly, stay out of sight lines and cameras, grab the goods and leave before the alarm. Being spotted fails the condition, so scout the store first and retry if you are seen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Silver. Bank vault robberies unlock in the later chapters — robbery trophies open up in Chapters 3 and 4 — so work through five vault jobs and get clear each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads; stop one, take the cash and escape the wanted level that follows. Trucks respawn, so if one attempt goes wrong, find another.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive through every named area until the map is filled in; the trophy tracks area discovery, so a slow tour of the state in free-roam finishes it. Use the map to spot the areas you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. Illegal operations are gang businesses marked around the map; hit one operation per gang. Keep a note of which gangs you have done, since the trophy only pops when all nine are covered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No launch guide has confirmed the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, 18 November 2026 — so this guide will not invent a location. The description points at a drink with an ocean view on Ocean Beach: try ordering a cocktail at a beachfront bar there. Treat any specific spot as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No launch guide has confirmed the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, 18 November 2026. The description evokes driving a car through a showroom's glass front in classic GTA style, so a stunt-style exit from a vehicle dealership is the obvious first try; treat any specific showroom as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to that bowling alley, play a frame and complete it — the 'follow-through' is the bowling motion, so finish a game there and the trophy pops. Bowling also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: No launch guide has confirmed the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, 18 November 2026. The wording suggests a partner milestone with an audience — likely tied to activities done together with your partner — but that is a reading of the description, not a verified method. Check PowerPyx's guide once it is confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count toward 500: keep making story and side choices as you play and the counter climbs. It is a long-haul counter, so do not chase it directly — it fills up across a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No launch guide has confirmed the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, 18 November 2026. The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, likely a failed-then-retried challenge or event, but that is a reading of the description, not a verified method. Check PowerPyx's guide once it is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No launch guide has confirmed the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, 18 November 2026. The wording points at a random or easter-egg event, something strange happening somewhere in Leonida, but no guide has pinned down where or what. Treat any claimed spot as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No launch guide has confirmed the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, 18 November 2026. The name and description point at knocking things down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style, but the exact target is unverified. Check PowerPyx's guide once it is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It pairs naturally with the robbery trophies — keep laundering as you rob.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending counts across every store, so big purchases — vehicles, weapons, clothes — push the total along. It fills up naturally across a full playthrough if you spend as you earn.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Buy every garage property on the market; they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Save up and buy them as they become affordable.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the in-game Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — ten registrations pop it. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most.
